title: pachycarpus distinctus
intro: Pachycarpus distinctus, commonly known as Desert Rose, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Desert Rose are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pachycarpus distinctus include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
